comment: Mock LLM response for Travel Advisory Agent - State Dept advisory

advisory_level_1.advisory_summary: Exercise normal precautions when traveling to Portugal.
specific_warnings: Petty crime such as pickpocketing occurs in tourist areas

advisory_level_2.advisory_summary: Exercise increased caution in Mexico due to crime and kidnapping.
specific_warnings: Violent crime such as homicide and kidnapping is widespread
Do not travel to certain states due to crime and gang activity
U.S. government employees require special authorization for travel to certain areas

advisory_level_3.advisory_summary: Reconsider travel to Pakistan due to terrorism and sectarian violence.
specific_warnings: Terrorist groups continue to plan attacks in Pakistan
Sectarian violence is common in certain regions
Anti-Western sentiment may be directed at U.S. citizens

advisory_level_4.advisory_summary: Do not travel to Syria due to terrorism, civil unrest, and armed conflict.
specific_warnings: No U.S. consular services are available in Syria
Armed conflict and terrorism throughout the country
Risk of kidnapping, detention, and violence against foreigners
